    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.site_id,
        a.shelter_rank,
        COUNT(b.id) AS rampart_level,
        SUM(b.kwh) AS prior_kwh_12h
    FROM indigo_stadiums a
    LEFT JOIN indigo_stadiums b
      ON b.site_id = a.site_id
     AND b.shelter_rank < a.shelter_rank
     AND b.shelter_rank >= a.shelter_rank - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.shelter_rank
),
per_group AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        rampart_level,
        site_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT site_id) AS distinct_site_ids,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_kwh_12h, 0.5) AS median_prior_kwh_12h,
        SUM(prior_kwh_12h) AS total_prior_kwh_12h,
        MIN(rampart_level) AS caravan_score,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(rampart_level, 0.5) AS median_prior_rows_12h
    FROM joined_ranges
    GROUP BY rampart_level, site_id
)
SELECT
    rampart_level,
    site_id,
    distinct_site_ids,
    median_prior_kwh_12h,
    total_prior_kwh_12h,
    caravan_score,
    median_prior_rows_12h,
    LEAST(rampart_level, total_prior_kwh_12h) AS least_prior_rows_12h_total_prior_kwh_12h
FROM per_group
ORDER BY caravan_score NULLS LAST, median_prior_kwh_12h

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

joined_ranges = (
    df_indigo_stadiums.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_indigo_stadiums.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.site_id") == F.col("a.site_id"))

        & (F.col("b.shelter_rank") >= F.col("a.shelter_rank") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.shelter_rank")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("rampart_level"),
        F.sum("b.kwh").alias("prior_kwh_12h"),
    )
)

per_group = (
    joined_ranges
    .groupBy("rampart_level", "site_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("site_id").alias("distinct_site_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("prior_kwh_12h", 0.5).alias("median_prior_kwh_12h"),
        F.sum("prior_kwh_12h").alias("total_prior_kwh_12h"),
        F.min("rampart_level").alias("caravan_score"),
        F.percentile_approx("rampart_level", 0.5).alias("median_prior_rows_12h"),
    )
)

result = (
    per_group
    .select(
        "rampart_level",
        "site_id",
        "distinct_site_ids",
        "median_prior_kwh_12h",
        "total_prior_kwh_12h",
        "caravan_score",
        "median_prior_rows_12h",
        F.least(F.col("rampart_level"), F.col("total_prior_kwh_12h")).alias("least_prior_rows_12h_total_prior_kwh_12h"),
